purpose: Independent sustained natural heavy rain beds for the new storm derivative
notes: Two independent continuous rainfall-only studies. These are genuine model masters, not synthesized noise or copied layering. They may be blended with a separately generated actual thunder event with exact placement documented in source provenance.

assets.title: Sustained heavy woodland rain bed
assets.role: Dense full continuous natural heavy rainfall without thunder
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, Heavy rain falling steadily outside in a quiet forest clearing. Thousands of overlapping water drops pour continuously onto soft leaves and forest earth, creating a dense broad full natural rainfall wash. A sustained abundant downpour with gently changing natural density, clear detailed water texture and a steady even open air perspective for the entire recording. Only continuous heavy rain is audible. Length: 30 seconds.

assets.title: Sustained broad rain shower bed
assets.role: An independent full heavy rain wash with sustained fine water impacts
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, Clear natural outdoor recording of an abundant heavy rain shower pouring over a wide area of soft woodland ground. Dense fine raindrops overlap into a continuous broad rushing water texture, rich natural high frequency rain detail and a soft full middle frequency body. Rainfall stays present and steadily heavy from start to finish, with small natural variations and no separate events. Only heavy rain in open air. Length: 30 seconds.
